### Ameriprise Financial Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results


July 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/618704162/files/doc_news/Ameriprise-Financial-Announces-Second-Quarter-2026-Results-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) today announced its second quarter 2026 results via an earnings release available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[https://ir.ameriprise.com/financials/quarterly-results/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2F&esheet=54575481&newsitemid=20260722315917&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2F&index=1&md5=7ef138701260e5a43c7a71a0e0c7ff5b) .


Management will host an investor conference call to review the results at approximately 8:30 a.m. (ET) today. Live audio of the conference call, presentation slides and an audio replay will be available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[ir.ameriprise.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ameriprise.com&esheet=54575481&newsitemid=20260722315917&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.ameriprise.com&index=2&md5=2677844b7e6391d031165857b18a41f0) .


At Ameriprise Financial, we have been helping people feel confident about their financial future for more than 130 years. With extensive investment advice, global asset management capabilities and insurance solutions, and a nationwide network of more than 10,000 financial advisors, we have the strength and expertise to serve the full range of individual and institutional investors' financial needs.
